checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan v0.4: dogfood the manifest gate in AIKit Phase 4 and add JSON reports

impact_assessment.why: A green AIKit check should also prove the project's committed fixtures, and CI systems need machine-readable results
impact_assessment.benefits: Fixture drift fails the same gate as tests; JSON output enables dashboards and automation
impact_assessment.risks: contract: JSON report schema and gate name are public; dependency: std only; concurrency: sequential; state: report builder must be pure
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioned JSON schema with golden tests, a pure report module, and a full gate re-run after config change

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan v0.5: seed override and stdin schema input

impact_assessment.why: Scripts need to explore seeds and pipe schemas without creating temporary files
impact_assessment.benefits: A single seed can be overridden on the CLI; schemas can come from stdin; still no state outside the machine
impact_assessment.risks: contract: --seed and '-' path are new inputs; dependency: std only; concurrency: single-threaded; state: seed override must flow through the same machine fields
impact_assessment.mitigation: Golden tests for seed override, stdin integration test, ADR recorded before edits

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan v0.6: deterministic corpus generation across a seed range

impact_assessment.why: Property-based testing needs a stable corpus of many seeds, generated once and reviewed like any other fixture
impact_assessment.benefits: A reproducible directory of fixtures from one schema; explicit write phases; bounded output
impact_assessment.risks: contract: corpus filenames and bounds are public; dependency: std only; concurrency: sequential writes; state: an explicit machine must own the write loop
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound the range to 1000 seeds, golden tests for filenames and bytes, ADR recorded before edits

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan v0.9: validate a committed fixture against its schema

impact_assessment.benefits: Reviewers can check edited fixtures for type and bound violations before CI; JSON and CSV both covered
